title: Chinese and Hong Kong chip distributors: listed firms, franchise terms, agency model and role in export-control leakage
why_it_matters: China/HK is ~62% of top-50 Asian distribution revenue and 19 of ECIA's top-50 authorized distributors are Chinese, yet the atlas has no records of their business model, filings or regulatory exposure.
questions: Which Chinese distributors are listed (SSE/SZSE/HKEX) and what do their annual reports disclose on franchise lines, margins and customers?
How do Chinese franchise/agency terms differ from Western ones?
How do Hong Kong traders and distributors appear in BIS Entity List and DOJ cases?
primary_sources: SSE/SZSE annual reports of listed Chinese distributors (e.g. Shannon Semi, Wuhan P&S, CECport, Best of Best)
HKEX filings of S.A.S. Dragon and Smart-Core Holdings
BIS Entity List entries and DOJ cases naming Hong Kong trading firms
